decode_mode.reason: This broad decode mode reproduces the previously validated LLVM conservative 524873-slot graph and is used only as a decoding aid; it is not a claim about retail hardware ISA extensions.

historical_intermediate_reference.note: This September 21 adr-coverage count predates Recovery F/G/J and remains a comparison reference, not a final Recovery J identity.

claim_boundary: The conservative LLVM tree now has only three explicit unknown/unsupported words and fully links, but it is still not claimed equivalent to Recovery J. Relative-table and other indirect roots remain diagnostic until canonical frontend parity is established.

changes: Preserve condition-failed fallthrough for predicated indirect PC writes/branches, matching the pinned frontend.
Do not interpret the trailing 'ls' in vmls/vnmls as an ARM LS condition suffix.
Promote vldmia/vstmia to the existing pinned VFP transport backend.

relative_pointer_table_experiment.detail: The preserved >=8-entry self-relative-table rule identified 22 candidate tables / 296 words and raised LLVM reachability to 548553 slots. Because the LLVM compatibility decoder is not the canonical Capstone frontend and this exceeded the earlier 547756-slot checkpoint, those roots remain diagnostic only.
